segments.ja533:1.3: Gaccha tuvampi mā kaṅkhi, natthi baddhe [bandhe (syā. ka.)] sahāyatā”.
segments.ja533:2.1: “Gacche vāhaṃ na vā gacche, na tena amaro siyaṃ;
segments.ja533:2.3: Sukhitaṃ taṃ upāsitvā, dukkhitaṃ taṃ kathaṃ jahe.
segments.ja533:3.1: “Maraṇaṃ vā tayā saddhiṃ, jīvitaṃ vā tayā vinā;
segments.ja533:3.3: Tadeva maraṇaṃ seyyo, yañce jīve tayā vinā.
segments.ja533:4.1: “Nesa dhammo mahārāja, yaṃ taṃ evaṃ gataṃ jahe;
segments.ja533:4.3: Yā gati tuyhaṃ sā mayhaṃ, ruccate vihagādhipa.
segments.ja533:5.1: “Kā nu pāsena baddhassa [bandhassa (syā. ka.)], gati aññā mahānasā;
segments.ja533:5.3: Sā kathaṃ cetayānassa, muttassa tava ruccati.
segments.ja533:6.1: “Kaṃ vā tvaṃ passase atthaṃ, mama tuyhañca pakkhima;
segments.ja533:7.1: “Yaṃ na kañcanadepiñcha [depiccha (sī. pī.), dvepiccha (syā.)], andhena tamasā gataṃ;
segments.ja533:8.1: “Kathaṃ nu patataṃ seṭṭha, dhamme atthaṃ na bujjhasi [bujjhase (sī.)];
segments.ja533:8.3: Dhammo apacito santo, atthaṃ dasseti pāṇinaṃ.
segments.ja533:10.1: “Addhā eso sataṃ dhammo, yo mitto mittamāpade;
segments.ja533:11.1: “Svāyaṃ dhammo ca te ciṇṇo, bhatti ca viditā mayi;
segments.ja533:12.1: “Api tvevaṃ gate kāle, yaṃ khaṇḍaṃ [baddhaṃ (sī.), bandhaṃ (pī.)] ñātinaṃ mayā;
segments.ja533:12.3: Tayā taṃ buddhisampannaṃ [buddhisampanna (sī. syā. pī.)], assa paramasaṃvutaṃ.
segments.ja533:14.3: Tuṇhīmāsittha ubhayo, na sañcalesumāsanā [na ca sañcesu’ māsanā (sī. pī.)].
segments.ja533:16.3: Paccakamittha [paccakampittha (sī. syā. pī.)] nesādo, baddhā iti vicintayaṃ.
segments.ja533:19.1: “Yaṃ nu pāsena mahatā, baddho na kurute disaṃ;
segments.ja533:19.3: Atha kasmā abaddho tvaṃ, balī pakkhi na gacchasi.
segments.ja533:20.1: “Kinnu tyāyaṃ [tā’ yaṃ (sī. pī. ka.)] dijo hoti, mutto baddhaṃ upāsasi;
segments.ja533:20.3: Ohāya sakuṇā yanti, kiṃ eko avahīyasi”.
segments.ja533:21.1: “Rājā me so dijāmitta, sakhā pāṇasamo ca me;
segments.ja533:21.3: Neva naṃ vijahissāmi, yāva kālassa pariyāyaṃ.
segments.ja533:23.3: Atha jālañca pāsañca, āsajjāpi na bujjhati.
segments.ja533:24.1: “Api tveva mahāpañña, pāsā bahuvidhā tatā [tatā (syā. ka.)];
segments.ja533:25.1: “Api nāyaṃ tayā saddhiṃ, saṃvāsassa [sambhāsassa (sī. pī.)] sukhudrayo;
segments.ja533:25.3: Api no anumaññāsi, api no jīvitaṃ dade”.
segments.ja533:26.1: “Na ceva me tvaṃ baddhosi, napi icchāmi te vadhaṃ;
segments.ja533:26.3: Kāmaṃ khippamito gantvā, jīva tvaṃ anigho ciraṃ”.
segments.ja533:27.3: Sace ekena tuṭṭhosi, muñcetaṃ mañca bhakkhaya.
segments.ja533:28.3: Na te lābhena jīvatthi [jīnatthi (sī. syā. pī.)], etena niminā tuvaṃ.
segments.ja533:29.1: “Tadiṅgha samapekkhassu [samavekkhasu (sī. pī.)], hotu giddhi tavamhasu [tavasmasu (sī. syā.)];
segments.ja533:29.3: Maṃ pubbe bandha pāsena, pacchā muñca dijādhipaṃ.
segments.ja533:30.1: “Tāvadeva ca te lābho, katāssa [katassā (sī. pī.)] yācanāya ca;
segments.ja533:30.3: Mitti ca dhataraṭṭhehi, yāvajīvāya te siyā”.
segments.ja533:31.1: “Passantu no mahāsaṅghā, tayā muttaṃ ito gataṃ;
segments.ja533:31.3: Mittāmaccā ca bhaccā ca, puttadārā ca bandhavā.
segments.ja533:32.1: “Na ca te tādisā mittā, bahūnaṃ [bahunnaṃ (sī. pī.)] idha vijjati;
segments.ja533:33.1: “So te sahāyaṃ muñcāmi, hotu rājā tavānugo;
segments.ja533:36.3: Lābhaṃ tavāyaṃ [yathāyaṃ (sī. pī.)] dhataraṭṭho, pāpaṃ kiñci [kañci (sī.)] na dakkhati.
segments.ja533:37.1: “Khippamantepuraṃ netvā [gantvā (syā. ka.)], rañño dassehi no ubho;
segments.ja533:39.3: Patīto sumano vitto [citto (ka.)], bahuṃ dassati te dhanaṃ”.
segments.ja533:42.1: “Kathaṃ panime vihaṅgā [vihagā (sī. pī.)], tava hatthattamāgatā [hatthattha’ māgatā (sī. syā. pī.)];
segments.ja533:42.3: Kathaṃ luddo mahantānaṃ, issare idha ajjhagā”.
segments.ja533:45.3: Bhatturatthe parakkanto, dhammayutto [dhamme yutto (sī. pī.)] vihaṅgamo.
segments.ja533:47.3: Tato naṃ pāmuciṃ [pāmuñciṃ (pī. ka.)] pāsā, anuññāsiṃ sukhena ca.
segments.ja533:50.3: Lābhaṃ tavāyaṃ dhataraṭṭho, pāpaṃ kiñci na dakkhati.
segments.ja533:53.3: Patīto sumano vitto, bahuṃ dassati te dhanaṃ’.
segments.ja533:54.3: Ettheva hi ime āsuṃ [assu (sī. syā. pī.)], ubho anumatā mayā.
segments.ja533:59.3: Atho raṭṭhamidaṃ phītaṃ, dhammena manusāsahaṃ”[manusissati (sī. pī.)].
segments.ja533:60.1: “Kacci bhoto amaccesu, doso koci na vijjati;
segments.ja533:60.3: Kacci ca [kaccinnu (sī. pī.)] te tavatthesu, nāvakaṅkhanti jīvitaṃ”.
segments.ja533:61.1: “Athopi me amaccesu, doso koci na vijjati;
segments.ja533:61.3: Athopi te [athopime (sī. pī.)] mamatthesu, nāvakaṅkhanti jīvitaṃ”.
segments.ja533:64.1: “Bhavantaṃ [bhavaṃ tu (sī. pī.), bhavannu (syā.)] kacci nu mahā-sattuhatthattataṃ [hatthatthataṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] gato;
segments.ja533:65.3: Evametesaṃ jammānaṃ, pātikaṃ [pākatikaṃ (sī. pī.)] bhavati tāvade”.
segments.ja533:66.3: Na cāyaṃ kiñci rasmāsu, sattūva samapajjatha.
segments.ja533:68.3: Tato maṃ pāmucī pāsā, anuññāsi sukhena ca.
segments.ja533:70.3: Eso cāpi bahuṃ vittaṃ, labhataṃ yāvadicchati”[yāvaticchati (sī. pī.)].
segments.ja533:72.3: Sabbatthissariyaṃ tava [sabbatthissariyaṃ bhavataṃ (sī. syā. pī.), sabbissariyaṃ bhavataṃ (syā. ka.)], taṃ pasāsa [pasāsatha (sī. syā. pī.)] yadicchatha.
segments.ja533:73.3: Etaṃ dadāmi vo vittaṃ, issariyaṃ [isseraṃ (sī.), issaraṃ (pī.)] vissajāmi vo”.
segments.ja533:75.3: Paṭivattuṃ na sakkomi, na me so vinayo siyā.
segments.ja533:78.3: Na heva akatattassa, nayo etādiso siyā.
segments.ja533:79.3: Yāvatatthi mayā diṭṭhā, nāññaṃ passāmi edisaṃ.
segments.ja533:80.3: Eso cāpi mamacchando, ciraṃ passeyya vo ubho”.
segments.ja533:81.1: “Yaṃ kiccaṃ [yaṃkiñci (pī.)] parame mitte, katamasmāsu [rasmāsu (sī. pī.)] taṃ tayā;
segments.ja533:81.3: Pattā nissaṃsayaṃ tyāmhā [tyamhā (pī.)], bhattirasmāsu yā tava.
segments.ja533:82.3: Adassanena asmākaṃ [amhākaṃ (sī. pī.)], dukkhaṃ bahūsu pakkhisu.
segments.ja533:83.3: Taṃ padakkhiṇato katvā, ñātiṃ [ñātī (sī. syā. pī.)] passemurindama [passemarindama (sī. pī.)].
segments.ja533:84.3: Eso cāpi mahā attho, ñātivissāsanā siyā”.
segments.ja533:87.3: Samantā parikiriṃsu [parikariṃsu (sī. syā. pī.)], aṇḍajā laddhapaccayā”.

lines: Samuḍḍenteti maraṇabhayena ito cito ca uppatante disvā.
Paccakamitthāti “baddhā, na baddhā”ti cintento upadhārento akamittha, vegaṃ hāpetvā saṇikaṃ agamāsi.
Āsajja baddhamāsīnanti baddhaṃ mahāsattaṃ upagantvā nisinnaṃ sumukhaṃ.
Vimatoti kiṃ nu kho abaddho baddhassa santike nisinno, kāraṇaṃ pucchissāmīti vimatijāto hutvāti attho.
Paṇḍareti haṃse, atha vā parisuddhe nimmale, sampahaṭṭhakañcanavaṇṇeti attho.
Yaṃ nūti yaṃ tāva eso mahāpāsena baddho.
Na kurute disanti palāyanatthāya ekaṃ disaṃ na bhajati, taṃ yuttanti adhippāyo.
Yāva kālassa pariyāyanti yāva maraṇassa vāro āgacchati.
Kathaṃ panāyanti tvaṃ rājā me soti vadasi, rājāno ca nāma paṇḍitā honti, itipi paṇḍito samāno kena kāraṇena oḍḍitaṃ pāsaṃ na addasa.
Padaṃ hetanti yasamahattaṃ vā ñāṇamahattaṃ vā pattānaṃ attano āpadabujjhanaṃ nāma padaṃ kāraṇaṃ, tasmā te āpadaṃ boddhumarahanti.
Guyhamāsajjāti tesu pāsesu yo guḷho paṭicchanno pāso, taṃ āsajja bajjhanti.
Iti naṃ so kathāsallāpena muduhadayaṃ katvā mahāsattassa jīvitaṃ yācanto gāthamāha –
Api no anumaññāsi, api no jīvitaṃ dade”ti.
Api no anumaññāsīti cittakūṭaṃ gantvā ñātake passituṃ tvaṃ api no anujāneyyāsi.
Api no jīvitaṃ dadeti api no imāya kathāya uppannavissāso na māreyyāsīti.
“Na ceva me tvaṃ baddhosi, napi icchāmi te vadhaṃ;
Kāmaṃ khippamito gantvā, jīva tvaṃ anigho ciran”ti.
Sace ekena tuṭṭhosi, muñcetaṃ mañca bhakkhaya.
Na te lābhena jīvatthi, etena niminā tuvaṃ.
Maṃ pubbe bandha pāsena, pacchā muñca dijādhipaṃ.
“Tāvadeva ca te lābho, katāssa yācanāya ca;
Mitti ca dhataraṭṭhehi, yāvajīvāya te siyā”ti.
Tattha etanti yaṃ aññatra etassa jīvitā mama jīvitaṃ, etaṃ ahaṃ neva icchāmi.
Tavamhasūti tava amhesu giddhi hotu, kiṃ te etena, mayi lobhaṃ uppādehīti vadati.
Yācanāya cāti yā mama yācanā, sāva katā assāti attho.
Iti so tāya dhammadesanāya tele pakkhittakappāsapicu viya mudugatahadayo mahāsattaṃ tassa dāyaṃ katvā dadanto āha –
“Passantu no mahāsaṅghā, tayā muttaṃ ito gataṃ;
Mittāmaccā ca bhaccā ca, puttadārā ca bandhavā.
“Na ca te tādisā mittā, bahūnaṃ idha vijjati;
“So te sahāyaṃ muñcāmi, hotu rājā tavānugo;
Tayā muttanti imañhi tvaññeva muñcasi nāma, tasmā imaṃ tayā muttaṃ ito cittakūṭapabbataṃ gataṃ mahantā ñātisaṅghā ete ca mittādayo passantu.
Pāṇasādhāraṇoti sādhāraṇapāṇo avibhattajīviko, yathā tvaṃ etassa sakhā, etādisā aññesaṃ bahūnaṃ mittā nāma na vijjanti.
Tavānugoti etaṃ dukkhitaṃ ādāya purato gacchantassa tava ayaṃ anugo hotūti.

Evaṃ vatvā pana nesādaputto mettacittena mahāsattaṃ upasaṅkamitvā bandhanaṃ chinditvā āliṅgitvā sarato nikkhāmetvā saratīre taruṇadabbatiṇapiṭṭhe nisīdāpetvā pāde bandhanapāsaṃ muducittena saṇikaṃ mocetvā dūre khipitvā mahāsatte balavasinehaṃ paccupaṭṭhāpetvā mettacittena udakaṃ ādāya lohitaṃ dhovitvā punappunaṃ parimajji.
Tassa mettacittānubhāvena bodhisattassa pāde sirā sirāhi, maṃsaṃ maṃsena, cammaṃ cammena ghaṭitaṃ, tāvadeva pādo saṃruḷho sañjātachavisañjātalomo ahosi abaddhapādena nibbiseso.
Atha sumukho attānaṃ nissāya mahāsattassa sukhitabhāvaṃ disvā sañjātasomanasso nesādassa thutimakāsi.
Evaṃ luddassa thutiṃ katvā sumukho bodhisattaṃ āha –

“mahārāja, iminā amhākaṃ mahāupakāro kato, ayañhi amhākaṃ vacanaṃ akatvā kīḷāhaṃse no katvā issarānaṃ dento bahuṃ dhanaṃ labheyya, māretvā maṃsaṃ vikkiṇanto mūlampi labhetha, attano pana jīvitaṃ anoloketvā amhākaṃ vacanaṃ akari, imaṃ rañño santikaṃ netvā sukhajīvitaṃ karomā”ti.

Sumukho attano bhāsāya mahāsattena saddhiṃ kathetvā puna manussabhāsāya luddaputtaṃ āmantetvā “samma, tvaṃ kimatthaṃ pāse oḍḍesī”ti pucchitvā “dhanatthan”ti vutte “evaṃ sante amhe ādāya nagaraṃ pavisitvā rañño dassehi, bahuṃ te dhanaṃ dāpessāmī”ti vatvā āha –
Lābhaṃ tavāyaṃ dhataraṭṭho, pāpaṃ kiñci na dakkhati.
Patīto sumano vitto, bahuṃ dassati te dhanan”ti.
Rañño dassehi no ubhoti amhe ubhopi rañño dassehi.
Ayaṃ bodhisattassa paññāpabhāvadassanatthaṃ, attano mittadhammassa āvibhāvanatthaṃ, luddassa dhanalābhatthaṃ, rañño sīlesu patiṭṭhāpanatthañcāti catūhi kāraṇehi evamāha.
Dhataraṭṭhāti netvā ca pana rañño evaṃ ācikkheyyāsi,“mahārāja, ime dhataraṭṭhakule jātā dve haṃsādhipatino, etesu ayaṃ rājā, itaro senāpatī”ti.

Evaṃ vutte luddo,“sāmi, mā vo rājadassanaṃ rucci, rājāno nāma calacittā, kīḷāhaṃse vā vo kareyyuṃ mārāpeyyuṃ vā”ti vatvā,“samma, mā bhāyi, ahaṃ tādisaṃ kakkhaḷaṃ luddaṃ lohitapāṇiṃ dhammakathāya mudukaṃ katvā mama pādesu pātesiṃ, rājāno nāma puññavanto paññavanto ca subhāsitadubbhāsitaññū ca, khippaṃ amhe rañño dassehī”ti vutte “tena hi mā mayhaṃ kujjhittha, ahaṃ avassaṃ tumhākaṃ ruciyā nemī”ti vatvā ubhopi kājaṃ āropetvā rājakulaṃ gantvā rañño dassetvā raññā puṭṭho yathābhūtaṃ ārocesi.
Kathaṃ luddo mahantānaṃ, issare idha ajjhagā.
Tato naṃ pāmuciṃ pāsā, anuññāsiṃ sukhena ca.
Lābhaṃ tavāyaṃ dhataraṭṭho, pāpaṃ kiñci na dakkhati.
Patīto sumano vitto, bahuṃ dassati te dhanaṃ.
Ettheva hi ime āsuṃ, ubho anumatā mayā.
Tattha kammunā upapādayīti yaṃ so avaca, taṃ karonto kāyakammena sampādesi.

Gantvāti haṃsarājena nisinnakājakoṭiṃ uccataraṃ, senāpatinā nisinnakājakoṭiṃ thokaṃ nīcaṃ katvā ubhopi te ukkhipitvā “haṃsarājā ca senāpati ca rājānaṃ passituṃ gacchanti, ussaratha ussarathā”ti janaṃ ussārento “evarūpā nāma sobhaggappattā suvaṇṇavaṇṇā haṃsarājāno na diṭṭhapubbā”ti muduhadayesu manussesu pasaṃsantesu khippamantepuraṃ gantvā.
Adassayīti “haṃsarājāno tumhe daṭṭhuṃ āgatā”ti rañño ārocāpetvā tena tuṭṭhacittena “āgacchantū”ti pakkosāpito abhiharitvā dassesi.
Mahantānanti yasamahantappattānaṃ suvaṇṇavaṇṇānaṃ dhataraṭṭhahaṃsānaṃ issare sāmino kathaṃ tvaṃ luddo hutvā adhigatoti pucchati.
“Issaramidhamajjhagā” tipi pāṭho, etesaṃ issariyaṃ tvaṃ kathaṃ ajjhagāti attho.
Yaṃ yadāyatanaṃ maññeti, mahārāja, yaṃ yaṃ samosaraṇaṭṭhānaṃ dijānaṃ pāṇarodhanaṃ jīvitakkhayakaraṃ maññāmi, tattha tattha mayā pallalesu pāsā vihitā.
Tādisanti mānusiyasare tathāvidhaṃ pāṇarodhanaṃ mayā vihitaṃ pāsaṃ.
Mamāyanti maṃ ayaṃ senāpati ajjhabhāsatha, mayā saddhiṃ kathesi.
Sudukkaranti tasmiṃ khaṇe esa amhādisehi anariyehi sudukkaraṃ akāsi.
Dahate bhāvamuttamaṃ, attano uttamaṃ ajjhāsayaṃ dahati vidahati pakāseti.
Anutthunantoti bhattuguṇe vaṇṇento tassa jīvitaṃ muñcāti maṃ yāci.
Sukhena cāti yathāsukhena cittakūṭaṃ gantvā ñātisaṅghaṃ passathāti ca anujāniṃ.
Ettheva hīti mayā pana ime dve ettha mānusiyasareyeva cittakūṭagamanāya anumatā ahesuṃ.
Sabbasākuṇikāgāmeti sabbasmimpi sākuṇikagāme nāhaṃ aññaṃ tava evarūpaṃ kenaci sākuṇikena ābhatapubbaṃ upāyanaṃ passāmi.
Taṃ passāti taṃ mayā ābhataṃ upāyanaṃ passa manujādhipāti.
Evaṃ so ṭhitakova sumukhassa guṇaṃ kathesi.

Tato rājā haṃsarañño mahārahaṃ āsanaṃ, sumukhassa ca suvaṇṇabhaddapīṭhakaṃ dāpetvā tesaṃ tattha nisinnānaṃ suvaṇṇabhājanehi lājamadhuphāṇitādīni dāpetvā niṭṭhite pānabhojanakicce añjaliṃ paggayha mahāsattaṃ dhammakathaṃ yācitvā suvaṇṇapīṭhake nisīdi.
So tena yācito paṭisanthāraṃ tāva akāsi.
“Kacci nu bhoto kusalaṃ, kacci bhoto anāmayaṃ;
“Kacci bhoto amaccesu, doso koci na vijjati;
Kacci ca te tavatthesu, nāvakaṅkhanti jīvitaṃ.
“Athopi me amaccesu, doso koci na vijjati;
Nāvakaṅkhantīti uraṃ datvā pariccajantā kicci attano jīvitaṃ na patthenti, jīvitañca cajitvā tavevatthaṃ karonti.
Puttarūpayasūpetāti puttehi ca rūpena ca yasena ca upetā.
Tava chandavasānugāti kacci tava ajjhāsayaṃ tava vasaṃ anuvattati, na attano cittavasena vattatīti pucchati.
Evaṃ bodhisattena paṭisanthāre kate puna rājā tena saddhiṃ kathento āha –
Na cāyaṃ kiñci rasmāsu, sattūva samapajjatha.
Tato maṃ pāmucī pāsā, anuññāsi sukhena ca.
Eso cāpi bahuṃ vittaṃ, labhataṃ yāvadicchatī”ti.
Tattha mahāsattuhatthattataṃ gatoti mahantassa sattuno hatthattaṃ gato.
Idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti – etesañhi jammānaṃ tāvadeva evaṃ pākatikaṃ hoti, sakuṇe daṇḍena pothetvā jīvitakkhayaṃ pāpento dhanavetanaṃ labhatīti.
Paccagamitthāti, mahārāja, esa amhe disvā baddhāti saññāya thokaṃ osakkittha.
Dhanamicchatāti etassa dhanaṃ icchantena tava santikaṃ amhākaṃ āgamanaṃ cintitaṃ.
Svāgatañcevidanti mā bhonto cintayantu, bhavataṃ idaṃ idhāgamanaṃ svāgatameva.

Evañca pana vatvā rājā aññataraṃ amaccaṃ oloketvā “kiṃ karomi devā”ti vutte “imaṃ nesādaṃ kappitakesamassuṃ nhātānulittaṃ sabbālaṅkārapaṭimaṇḍitaṃ kāretvā ānehī”ti vatvā tena tathā katvā ānītassa tassa saṃvacchare saṃvacchare satasahassuṭṭhānakaṃ gāmaṃ, dve vīthiyo gahetvā ṭhitaṃ mahantaṃ gehaṃ, rathavarañca, aññañca bahuṃ hiraññasuvaṇṇaṃ adāsi.
So tassa dhammakathaṃ sutvā tuṭṭhahadayo “dhammakathikassa sakkāraṃ karissāmī”ti setacchattaṃ datvā rajjaṃ paṭicchāpento āha –
Etaṃ dadāmi vo vittaṃ, issariyaṃ vissajāmi vo”ti.
Tattha vaso vattatīti yattha mama vaso vattati.

Yaṃ caññaṃ upakappatīti puññakāmatāya dānatthaṃ vā chattaṃ ussāpetvā rajjameva upabhottuṃ vā yaṃ vā aññaṃ tumhākaṃ ruccati, taṃ karotha, etaṃ dadāmi vo vittaṃ, saddhiṃyeva setacchattena mama santakaṃ issariyaṃ vissajjāmi voti.
Atha mahāsatto raññā dinnaṃ setacchattaṃ puna tasseva adāsi.
“haṃsarañño tāva me dhammakathā sutā, luddaputtena pana ‘ayaṃ sumukho mudhurakatho’ti ativiya vaṇṇito, imassapi dhammakathaṃ sossāmī”ti.
So tena saddhiṃ sallapanto anantaraṃ gāthamāha –
Idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti – yadi ca me ayaṃ sumukho paṇḍito buddhisampanno kāmasā attano ruciyā ajjhabhāseyya, taṃ me paramappiyaṃ assāti.
Paṭivattuṃ na sakkomi, na me so vinayo siyā.
Tattha nāgarājārivantaranti peḷāya abbhantaraṃ paviṭṭho nāgarājā viya.
Paṭivattunti tumhākaṃ dvinnaṃ antare vattuṃ na sakkomi.
Na me soti sace vadeyyaṃ, na me so vinayo bhaveyya.
Pūjāti ubho tumhe mayhaṃ bahūhi kāraṇehi pūjārahā ceva pasaṃsārahā ca.
Rājā tassa vacanaṃ sutvā tuṭṭhahadayo “nesādaputto taṃ vaṇṇeti, na aññena tumhādisena madhuradhammakathikena nāma bhavitabban”ti vatvā āha –
Yāvatatthi mayā diṭṭhā, nāññaṃ passāmi edisaṃ.
Eso cāpi mamacchando, ciraṃ passeyya vo ubho”ti.
Nāññanti tasmiṃ mayā diṭṭhaṭṭhāne aññaṃ evarūpaṃ na passāmi.
Tuṭṭhosmi vo pakatiyāti samma haṃsarāja ahaṃ pakatiyā paṭhamameva tumhākaṃ dassanena tuṭṭho.
Ciraṃ passeyya voti idheva vasāpetvā muhuttampi avippavāsanto ciraṃ tumhe passeyyanti esa me chandoti vadati.
“Yaṃ kiccaṃ parame mitte, katamasmāsu taṃ tayā;
Pattā nissaṃsayaṃ tyāmhā, bhattirasmāsu yā tava.
Eso cāpi mahā attho, ñātivissāsanā siyā”ti.
Pattā nissaṃsayaṃ tyāmhāti mayaṃ nissaṃsayena tayā pattāyeva.
Bhattirasmāsu yā tavāti yā tava amhesu bhatti, tāya bhattiyā mayaṃ tayā asaṃsayena pattāyeva, na ca vippayuttā, vippavuṭṭhāpi sahavāsinoyeva nāma mayanti dīpeti.
Ñātisaṅghassa mantaranti amhehi dvīhi janehi virahitassa mama ñātisaṅghassa antaraṃ chiddaṃ.
Asmākanti amhākaṃ dvinnaṃ adassanena bahūsu pakkhīsu dukkhaṃ uppannaṃ.
Eso cāpi mahā atthoti yā esā ñātisaṅghasaṅkhātā ñātivissāsanā siyā, eso cāpi mahanto atthopi.
Evaṃ vutte rājā tesaṃ gamanaṃ anujāni.
Mahāsattopi rañño pañcavidhe dussīlye ādīnavaṃ, sīle ca ānisaṃsaṃ kathetvā “imaṃ sīlaṃ rakkha, dhammena rajjaṃ kārehi, catūhi saṅgahavatthūhi janaṃ saṅgaṇhāhī”ti ovaditvā cittakūṭaṃ agamāsi.

Tattha upāgamunti aruṇuggamanavelāyameva lājamadhuphāṇitādīni paribhuñjitvā raññā ca deviyā ca dvīhi suvaṇṇatālavaṇṭehi ukkhipitvā gandhamālādīhi katasakkārā tālavaṇṭehi otaritvā rājānaṃ padakkhiṇaṃ katvā vehāsaṃ uppatitvā raññā añjaliṃ paggayha “gacchatha sāmino”ti vutte sīhapañjarena nikkhantā uttamena javena gantvā ñātigaṇaṃ upāgamiṃsu.
Parikiriṃsūti bhattuno muttabhāvena tuṭṭhā taṃ bhattāraṃ samantā parivārayiṃsu.
Evaṃ parivāretvā pana te haṃsā “kathaṃ muttosi, mahārājā”ti pucchiṃsu.
Mahāsatto sumukhaṃ nissāya muttabhāvaṃ, sāgalarājaluddaputtehi katakammañca kathesi.
Taṃ sutvā tuṭṭho haṃsagaṇo “sumukhasenāpati ca rājā ca luddaputto ca sukhitā niddukkhā ciraṃ jīvantū”ti thutimakāsi.

Dhataraṭṭhāti haṃsarājā sumukho raññā ceva luddaputtena cāti dvīhi evaṃ ubhopi te dhataraṭṭhā kalyāṇamittasampannā yathā ñātisaṅghaṃ upāgamuṃ, ñātisaṅghaupagamanasaṅkhāto nesaṃ attho padakkhiṇo jāto, evaṃ aññesampi mittavataṃ atthā padakkhiṇā hontīti.
